name: Fall Armyworm Adult
symptoms: Egg masses covered with gray scales on leaves Presence of moths around crop fields at night
description: The adult fall armyworm is a nocturnal moth responsible for laying eggs on crop leaves. These eggs hatch into destructive larvae.
management: Use pheromone traps to monitor moth populations Destroy egg masses early Control larvae before they spread
prevention: Field monitoring with pheromone traps Plant resistant crop varieties Maintain crop diversity
